narrative_checks: Physical grid, construction, cooling and reliability cases carry the opening.
Frontier proper name and frontier-model capability distinguished.
Internal Chinchilla and Llama technical evidence retained; compute budget distinct from comparison budget.
DeepSeek assumed valuation and exclusions preserved; Stanford curated dataset boundary preserved.
INCITE allocated opportunities and LUMI operator account are not proof of realized welfare.
Scale benefits, financing, costs and private experimentation receive substantive treatment.
Pre-training, post-training, inference, shared artifacts and research access distinct.
No equations, fabricated interviews, author visits, invented private reactions, actual-firm finite-budget diagnosis or automatic welfare/legal conclusion.
Arrow is a bibliography addition; original 24 v5 entries and assignments preserved.
Llama failure coupling and automation supply concrete operating evidence; speculative diagnosis counts and independent-audit claims avoided.
Chinchilla bundled changes stated plainly; AEP Ohio survey example replaces another generic grid-cost scenario.
Both April and October IEA report dates confirmed; energy projection remains total data centers, not AI-only or observed future demand.
whole_book_review: Sequential chapter review completed for saved draft and recorded claims; final cross-book continuity, source completion and publication-date refresh remain. No independent proof/priority certification or current-market diagnosis.

sequential_review.method: Complete body and notes read in sequence after Chapter 6; revised passages re-read in their sections. New details checked against versioned originals and official IEA primary report/date metadata. Prior case boundaries retained.
findings: Grid, building, cooling, operating recovery and allocation stages remain distinct; Frontier proper name not conflated with frontier models.
April 2026 IEA estimate/projection scope preserved and unit explained; October report date verified against official landing page.
Single failure/slow straggler and rare significant manual intervention replace abstract operating discussion with developer evidence.
Private experiments, public capacity awards and released models can permit different learning; ownership, model ancestry and independence not conflated.
Training, post-training, inference and marginal serving resources remain distinct.
Chinchilla changed adjustment method, tokenization and data mix as well as size/tokens; no isolated model-size causal claim.
DeepSeek valuation/exclusions and Stanford curated-notability boundaries retained; no entry-cost constant, market definition, actual-firm finite budget or current capability ranking inferred.
AEP Ohio cost-allocation example attributed to IEA survey; speculation, underused capacity, risk allocation and welfare remain separate.
Arrow appropriation problem and Kerr et al. staged experimentation credited; no automatic sharing mandate, liability or tax conclusion.
Compute resource budget distinct from modeled allocation-chance budget; all informative tests count, and finite lifetime requires more than concentration.
